Hello Team,
The Emergency stop button is not pressed, however in the logs we see that the QA26 safety relay is activated.
Could you please trace the emergency wiring for the relay, and check if any of the safety switches are closed which has caused the emergency relay to activate?
Kindly check all the connections of SF2 to QA26.
Carry a spare if needed to replace.
